incidents.title: Repeated failed authentication
incidents.finding: At least 5 failed sign-ins from one source to one monitored host within 300 seconds.
nextSteps: Check whether this is a shared source IP or a user retrying a password.
Review affected accounts and nearby successful logins.

incidents.title: Administrator-group membership changed
incidents.finding: A privileged group change has no matching approval in the supplied change records. Missing approval is a review gap, not proof of malicious activity.
nextSteps: Validate the actor and affected member against the change request.
Check the account owner and relevant authentication activity.
Escalate an unapproved change through the incident process.

incidents.title: Monitored file changed
incidents.finding: A monitored file changed without a matching supplied approval record.
nextSteps: Compare file contents or hashes before and after the change.
Check the change window and responsible administrator.
Review nearby process activity and restore only after authorization.

limitations: Offline analysis; this program does not collect endpoint telemetry.
Alerts are investigation leads, not confirmed compromises.
Missing/local-only authentication IPs cannot be source-IP correlated.
Time-window analysis uses event timestamps; synchronize endpoint clocks.
Only the documented event types are normalized.
provenance: SYNTHETIC REPLAY. The input mimics documented Wazuh/Windows event structures. This report was produced by the local Node.js pipeline, not a live Wazuh installation.
